title: Improved Security Bounds for General Sponge Constructions
summary: Existing analysis does not directly cover general Sponge constructions lacking the double-keyed tag protocol; bounds narrowing the gap with recent attacks remain open.

formal_statement.body: For general Sponge constructions without the double-keyed tag-generation and tag-verification protocol, establish improved security bounds that narrow the gap between currently known security bounds and recent known attacks. Existing analysis does not directly apply to these constructions.

scope.domain: Security analysis of general Sponge constructions without the double-keyed tag-generation and tag-verification protocol.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish improved security bounds that narrow the gap between currently known bounds and recent known attacks.

progress.summary: The paper states that its analysis cannot be applied directly to general Sponge constructions without the double-keyed tag-generation and tag-verification protocol. It presents improving their security bounds in light of the gap with recent attacks as an open research problem.
citation_labels: Bishwajit Chakraborty et al., Exact Security Analysis of ASCON
